channel.title: Al-Jazeera Media Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Al-Jazeera Media Network (aljazeera.com)

item.title: Trump: Khamenei dead after US strikes Iran
item.description: US President Donald Trump says Iran’s Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei was killed in joint US-Israeli strikes.

item.title: US Ambassador to UN: Trump has ‘met the moment’ by striking Iran
item.description: The US Ambassador to the United Nations Mike Waltz says striking Iran was necessary to protect American allies.

item.title: Who is Ali Shamkhani, Iran official reportedly killed in US-Israel attacks?
item.description: The former defence minister and secretary of Iran's Defence Council was involved in US-Iran nuclear negotiations.

item.title: Missile debris injures eight in Qatar after Iran launches barrage
item.description: Interior Ministry official says 66 missiles were fired at Qatar, and there were 114 reports of falling shrapnel.

item.title: How have US politicians reacted to the attack on Iran?
item.description: Republicans largely rally behind Trump's strikes on Iran, while Democrats fail to offer singular message of opposition.

item.title: Iranian Ambassador to UN calls US-Israeli attacks a ‘war crime’
item.description: Iranian Ambassador to the United Nations, Amir-Saeid Iravani denounced US-Israeli military strikes across the country.

item.title: New Yorkers protest US strikes on Iran
item.description: New Yorkers protested Saturday hours after US President Donald Trump ordered a wave of deadly strikes on Iran.

item.title: US strikes on Iran lead to renewed demands for war powers legislation
item.description: Democratic lawmakers have largely condemned the strikes on Iran, emphasising the lack of congressional approval.

item.title: Netanyahu’s war? Analysts say Trump’s Iran strikes benefit Israel, not US
item.description: War with Iran contradicts the US president's own criticism of regime change policies in the Middle East, analysts say.

item.title: Despite antiwar MAGA wing, Trump gets Republican support for Iran strikes
item.description: Conservative opposition to war on Iran remains minimal as hawks heap praise on Trump for bombing, killing Khamenei.
